    The radical-square-zero one-loop three-leaf star is representation-infinite #

    The four arrows are indexed so that arrow 0 is the loop at the central vertex, while arrows 1, 2, and 3 go from the center to the three leaves.

                                    theorem LargeIndecomposable.LoopThreeStar.not_isRepresentationFinite (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k] :
                                    ¬IsRepresentationFinite k (StarAlgebra k)

                                    Over an infinite field, the radical-square-zero algebra of one central loop and three outward leaves is representation-infinite.
